planets.name: TOI-1227 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1227 with a 27.4-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1227 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1227. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 27.36137783684, pl_radj 0.854, pl_bmassj 0.209

quotes.title: TOI-1227 b
quotes.card: TOI-1227 b is one of the youngest transiting exoplanets discovered, alongside K2-33b and HIP 67522 b.
quotes.introduction: The exoplanet TOI-1227 b is 5–12 million years old and currently 9.6 R🜨 large.
